🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +6.96%) ↑ rising but SPY_TLT and credit signals read neutral per regime scoring, and leadership is mixed (Energy/Utilities up while Tech/Financials down), supporting a neutral regime.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Volatility elevated: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +6.96%) ↑ rising. Credit steady-to-easing: HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.69% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND → net neutral; Bonds offering shelter: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +2.36%) ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +2.36%) ↑ rising, HYG/LQD steady ABOVE TREND, yield-curve and dollar remain neutral in the regime readout.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive/cyclical bias: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +3.83%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +14.87%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +7.22%). Tech and Financials lag: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -3.23%), XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -1.62%) — style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.84% | 1M: -0.78%). EM outperformance concentrated: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.97% | 1M: +5.74%) while China remains weak: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -1.48%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation subdued: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -12.60%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -30.79%). Small caps not showing risk-on leadership: IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -0.67%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Bifurcated: Solar/mining and energy up — TAN ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +16.48%), XLE/BNO/USO ABOVE TREND — while industrial metals lag: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -1.00%) and gold in CORRECTION: GLD (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +8.78%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strong and confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +14.87%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.09% | 1M: +11.49%). Natural gas divergent: UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -2.14% | 1M: +14.91%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership (XLE ABOVE TREND both frames) and defensive breadth (XLU/XLP positive). DIVERGENCES: GLD and UNG show 1W vs 1M mismatch (CORRECTION), and speculative/theme names (IBIT, ARKK) remain BELOW TREND — no major multi-core timeframe divergence to force a regime flip.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Energy/Staples/Utilities ETFs (XLE, XLP, XLU) showing strength and monitor bond hedge TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +2.36%). Reduce exposure to high-beta Tech and thematic risk: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -3.23%), ARKK and IBIT BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +14.87%), XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +3.83%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +7.22%). BEARISH: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -3.23%), XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -1.62%), XME BELOW TREND (1W: -4.88% | 1M: -5.68%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.09% | 1M: +11.49%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +10.82%), TAN ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +16.48%). BEARISH: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -1.00%), SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -4.52% | 1M: -13.49%).

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX elevated levels via VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +6.96%) as a volatility trigger. Monitor HYG/LQD steadiness with HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.27%) and LQD (1W: +0.69% | 1M: +1.30%) for credit flow shifts, and the XLK/XLF leadership gap for a style inflection.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, regime supported by neutral risk ratios (VXX/SPY-TLT/HYG-LQD flagged neutral in scoring) and mixed leadership between strong Energy/Utilities and weak Tech/Financials. Energy (XLE) and defensives (XLU/XLP) showing strength while Tech (XLK BELOW TREND) and speculative ETFs (IBIT, ARKK BELOW TREND) are key divergences to monitor.
